predictions.text: I predict that the airport suspensions at a major international airport will be extended.

I predict that the co-production agreement between ABS-CBN and TV5 will be finalized as planned.
I predict that attacks on prominent airports in major cities will continue, with at least one more attack involving the firing of a missile, resulting in additional injuries.
I predict that 365,000 people in Alabama and Florida will have power restored by the end of Monday, 19 October 2026.
I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see another targeted vessel, likely involving Iran and the United States.
I predict that no new cases of Ebola will be reported in Kenya by the end of Monday, 19 October 2026, and 293 tests will have been conducted.
I predict that there will be another mass stabbing at a school in Poland by the end of Monday, 19 October 2026, possibly in a different city.
I predict that Ethiopian forces will capture another major town in the Tigray Region, following the recent recapture of Adigrat.
I predict that the search for survivors in the 2026 Budhi Gandaki flood will continue, with at least 10 survivors found in Nepal.
